scope: 第八轮训练场景覆盖修正：同一中心MSE权重起点、同更新预算；仅开发验证，不是独立确认
rationale: 第六轮前景可靠但中心和实例召回偏低；训练场景覆盖有限，已见与未见物体均有漏检。试验增加训练场景/样本的整体策略，不把故障单独归因于未见物体。
initialization: Only the same parent model tensors inherited; new identical optimizer/scheduler/scaler/RNG/local cursor; neither arm inherits optimization state
new_scene_selection: Ascending fixed training IDs excluding the old10 training scenes; take first10 before reading new images/results
checkpoint_selection: Final local step1600 only; evaluate all160 development frames only after fixed training budget; no validation-based early stop or checkpoint selection
comparison: Same model/loss/start/seed/LR/update budget. More distinct scenes and frames with fewer exposures per frame is one combined coverage strategy; it does not isolate object diversity from scene count, sample count, or repeat count. Per-arm orders differ intentionally with their datasets.
decision_rule: Adopt coverage_expanded only if its absolute gate and all relative rules pass; otherwise retain coverage_control only if its absolute gate passes; otherwise neither accepted. A completed negative experiment remains valid without claiming effect acceptance.
stop_rules: Stop on nonfinite state, invalid hash, resume mismatch or low disk
No threshold tuning or budget extension after results
Do not consume remaining validation, calibration or official test scenes
exclusions: All10 validation scenes are development data after previous use
No graspAP or robot success claim
Preserve previous runs and every negative result
